title: Stage 3: pre-registered robustness test of Fed-MediShield bsc_5 (history off) against three attack variants
written: 2026-10-06, before any run on seeds 68-70 and before calibration M
detector: Frozen Phase 2d detector: bsc_5, --history-channel off, detector core of logs/bsc5_logit_calL_histoff (checked by digest). Calibration M is a refit of the same inputs (no training/inference) for source 73b11858... which only adds --attack-variant. Authorization: the passed live gate logs/bsc5_histoff_devgate, used with the declared --attack-variant flag.
common: --loss-adjustment logit --logit-tau 0.5, 15 rounds, 8 clients, target Benign, attacked condition only, matched FedAvg (train_defended.py) per variant and seed

variants.V1_out_of_bank_trigger: --trigger-features 2 8 15 36 --trigger-value 4.5 --poison-rate 0.5 --malicious-ratio 0.25 (trigger chosen from clean models only: logs/select_trigger_outside_bank.py; no probe group or level equals it; single columns are still probed)

development_evidence_disclosed: V1 was run on development seeds 43 and 46 before this file (logs/stage3c_*_dev): final ASR 0.05/0.04%, but seed 46's largest attacker was first caught at its 6th poisoned update and ASR reached 87.5% in round 5.

per_seed_criteria.exposure_definition: rounds 2-15 in which the defended triggered->Benign rate exceeds 10% (round 1 precedes any possible detection)

decision_rule: Each variant is judged separately: SUPPORTED if every conclusive seed passes every criterion and at least two of three seeds are conclusive; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED (or INCONCLUSIVE if fewer than two are conclusive). All seeds and variants reported. No change after data are seen.
limits: Three seeds per variant is a small robustness check, not a full sensitivity study. No clean-run criteria here (covered by Phase 2d). No adaptive attacker.
